source.note: Lossless reviewed documents promoted from the authoritative World packs.

system.description:
Self-assertive, confident and energetic. Some call you brash; you act rather than wait to learn more.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Energetic: +2 to your Speed Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.jUTYItXojqpYujYN]{Initiative}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Intellect defense or endurance.

  • Suggested Inability: You were never good at studying or retaining facts. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.1ed6a9dae4acd3cb]{Researching}.
Your reactions are honed, easing your initiative tasks in combat.

Bravery is a conscious choice for you, not an absence of fear, and you can instil it in others.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Resolve: +2 to your Intellect Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.c4b6b98d92624257]{Persuasion}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Stealth or Might defense.

  • Suggested Inability: You're brave, but you have to talk yourself into it. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.jUTYItXojqpYujYN]{Initiative}.
You're adept at winning people to your side of an argument through truthful reasoning, understanding, and kindness.

Helping others is your calling, whether by treating injuries or keeping morale up.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Helpful: +2 to your Intellect Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.Y191mjA7nOu48LWp]{Healing}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Persuasion or psychology.

  • Suggested Inability: You're too much of a people person to dissemble well. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.9NS4fm5VOrlzRwHv]{Deception}.
You can attempt to diagnose physical illness, and you are skilled with healing tasks.

You study the particulars before you charge in. Others call it timid; you call it sense.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Cognizant: +2 to your Intellect Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.S9WFjHa5QI83AFQO]{Perception}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Researching or initiative.

  • Suggested Inability: Sometimes your caution leads to doubt. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.952bfb5f1296eb5b]{Discerning motive}.
You have a better chance to notice what others miss when searching an area, listening closely, or using some other sense to discover what is hidden or not obvious.

Jovial and outgoing. You meet each new challenge with a grin and put others at ease.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Witty: +2 to your Intellect Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.c4b6b98d92624257]{Persuasion}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Performance or healing.

  • Suggested Inability: You're lighthearted but not fast. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.ce059fe6f2651325]{Speed defense}.
You're adept at winning people to your side of an argument through truthful reasoning, understanding, and kindness.

You question claims others take for granted, and you have often been right to.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Skeptical: +2 to your Intellect Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.952bfb5f1296eb5b]{Discerning motive}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Any scientific area of knowledge, such as physics or astronomy.

  • Suggested Inability: You're so absorbed in working out what's going on that you're slow to react. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.ce059fe6f2651325]{Speed defense}.
You're practiced at ascertaining another character's lies, motives, and disposition.

The figure lurking quietly in the corner. Nobody knows where you came from or what you want.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.ZxPyYpNcbki4VN3z]{Stealth}.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.2253f39a79c36c71]{Intellect defense}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Deception or occultism.

  • Suggested Inability: You have almost as much trouble reading others as they do you. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.952bfb5f1296eb5b]{Discerning motive}.
You're adept at sneaking and hiding, staying out of sight, and keeping any noise of your presence to a minimum.
You are practiced at holding your nerve against fear, deceit, and anything that reaches for your mind.

A stickler for accuracy and detail. Everything you own is catalogued and in its place.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Careful: +2 to your Intellect Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.uzlopmNCJj8CpFlC]{Forensics}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Researching or identifying.

  • Suggested Inability: You can't stand disruptions, especially to your concentration. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.2253f39a79c36c71]{Intellect defense}.
You know how to interpret physical evidence to work out what happened at a location, such as a crime scene, or what led to an object's current condition, such as a cause of death.

Fight, flight or freeze — you have only ever felt the urge to fight. A true thrill-seeker.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Dauntless: +2 to your Might Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.2253f39a79c36c71]{Intellect defense}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Endurance or initiative.

  • Suggested Inability: Your fearlessness makes you impatient. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.ZxPyYpNcbki4VN3z]{Stealth}.
You are practiced at holding your nerve against fear, deceit, and anything that reaches for your mind.

Something in you screams to make them pay. You fold it away for your friends, but it is always there.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Brutish: +2 to your Might Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.SbEfC3bQGCbTDvOM]{Tracking}.

  • Bloodthirsty: Once you begin fighting, you see only red. The first attack you make in any given combat is eased.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Instead of an extra skill, you may take the Bloodthirsty characteristic.

  • Suggested Inability: You're easily provoked. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.2253f39a79c36c71]{Intellect defense}.
You know how to track a target through natural landscapes and urban environments.

You treat setbacks as stepping stones, and your empathy shows you others' inner battles.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Resilient: +2 to your Might Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.952bfb5f1296eb5b]{Discerning motive}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Persuasion or performance.

  • Suggested Inability: You always hope for the best, even when you should be preparing. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.1ed6a9dae4acd3cb]{Researching}.
You're practiced at ascertaining another character's lies, motives, and disposition.

You hunt the mysteries and occult secrets of the world, usually through somebody's archive.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Curious: +2 to your Intellect Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.1ed6a9dae4acd3cb]{Researching}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Any knowledge skill, such as astronomy, geography, or history.

  • Suggested Inability: When you see something interesting, you hesitate as you take it all in. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.jUTYItXojqpYujYN]{Initiative}.
You're skilled at gathering information from databases and physical archives, or by hitting the pavement and asking around. Every form of research takes at least a few hours.

Imposing in manner, stature, or both. There is a touch of danger about you, and people sense it.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Threatening: +2 to your Might Pool, or +2 to your Intellect Pool, or +1 to both Pools.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.TxjNz86eOB6UwTGb]{Intimidation}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Gunsmithing or deception.

  • Suggested Inability: You're threatening but not a quick study. Tasks related to lore and knowledge are hindered.
You're good at swaying others with threatening words and/or fearsome presence.

Charming and charismatic. People like you, want to help you, and want to be your friend.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Charismatic: +2 to your Intellect Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.c4b6b98d92624257]{Persuasion}.

  • Contact: You have an important contact in an influential position, such as a minor celebrity, a police captain, or the editor of a news organisation. Work out the details with the GM.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Instead of an extra skill, you may take the Contact characteristic.

  • Suggested Inability: Your willpower is not one of your strong points. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.2253f39a79c36c71]{Intellect defense}.
You're adept at winning people to your side of an argument through truthful reasoning, understanding, and kindness.

You are strong, and you enjoy the power and endurance that comes with it.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Strong: +2 to your Might Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.4057b66c1d139a6d]{Endurance}.

  • Breaking: Your tasks to smash physical objects — doors, containers, and other inanimate objects — are eased.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Instead of an extra skill, you may take the Breaking characteristic.

  • Suggested Inability: You're strong but not quick. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.jUTYItXojqpYujYN]{Initiative}.
Regular training has improved your physical fitness, easing your climbing, jumping, and swimming tasks, plus similar feats that require sustained strength.

The world is full of unsettling things and you are not imagining it. The unease keeps you on your toes.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Jumpy: +2 to your Speed Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.jUTYItXojqpYujYN]{Initiative}.

  • High-Strung: You gain an asset to your initiative tasks if you use your first action in an encounter to move a short distance away from whatever threatens you.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Instead of an extra skill, you may take the High-Strung characteristic.

  • Suggested Inability: You'll never convincingly make ultimatums. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.TxjNz86eOB6UwTGb]{Intimidation}.
Your reactions are honed, easing your initiative tasks in combat.

You hate frills, chitchat and gossip. You prize straight talk and the facts.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Austere: +2 to your Might Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.1ed6a9dae4acd3cb]{Researching}.

  • Resilient: You ignore the first 3 points of Stress you would otherwise take in a day from shock, such as Stress from experiencing something supernatural. Once that threshold is passed you suffer Stress normally until after your next ten-hour recovery roll, which resets it.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Instead of an extra skill, you may take the Resilient characteristic.

  • Suggested Inability: People react badly to your humourless ways. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.c4b6b98d92624257]{Persuasion}.
You're skilled at gathering information from databases and physical archives, or by hitting the pavement and asking around. Every form of research takes at least a few hours.

Some formative loss or judgement drives you, and no setback stops you pursuing it.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Dogged: +2 to your Might Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.Pcfq6GwGkU5Qi90s]{Identifying}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Any craft-related skill, such as carpentry, cooking, leatherworking, metalworking, or sewing.

  • Suggested Inability: You come across as so single-minded that you put people off. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.c4b6b98d92624257]{Persuasion}.
Your analytical mind lets you venture a guess regarding the origin of unfamiliar objects, texts, sounds, and so on.

You are sure you know the best way to handle anything, and few can change your mind.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Willful: +2 to your Intellect Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.2253f39a79c36c71]{Intellect defense}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Any technical expertise skill, such as programming, publishing, or researching.

  • Suggested Inability: Pomposity doesn't lend itself to likeability. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.c4b6b98d92624257]{Persuasion}.
You are practiced at holding your nerve against fear, deceit, and anything that reaches for your mind.

Right place, right time — or more often, out of the wrong place in time. Not luck: speed.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Swift: Quick offers no initial skill, but a larger stat Pool bonus.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Endurance or gymnastics.

  • Suggested Inability: You're quick, but not quick-witted when it comes to falsehoods. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.9NS4fm5VOrlzRwHv]{Deception}.

You harden your heart to others' suffering. What they call cruelty, you call pragmatism.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Hard: +2 to your Might Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.9NS4fm5VOrlzRwHv]{Deception}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Intimidation or stealth.

  • Suggested Inability: You have a hard time connecting with others or sharing their feelings. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.952bfb5f1296eb5b]{Discerning motive}.
You are a capable liar, able to use speech and the written word to deceive and misinform others.

You studied, alone or with an instructor, and you are an expert in a couple of fields.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Studied: Scholarly offers no initial stat Pool bonus, but another skill instead.

  • Skill: You're trained in One knowledge skill, such as philosophy, geography, or history.

  • Skill: You're trained in Another, different knowledge skill, such as astronomy, biology, or geology.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Identifying or researching.

  • Suggested Inability: You spend too long on scholarly pursuits to trust your empathy. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.952bfb5f1296eb5b]{Discerning motive}.
You are well-versed in the study of the stars, planets, and cosmology in general.
You have a deep working knowledge of living systems, including animals, plants, and insects.
You can design, analyze, and create innovative solutions for complex problems, utilizing scientific principles and technological knowledge.
You know how to interpret physical evidence to work out what happened at a location, such as a crime scene, or what led to an object's current condition, such as a cause of death.
You are well-versed in earthly landscapes, countries, human populations, and maps in general.
You're knowledgeable about Earth's structure, composition, and processes, including earthquakes, volcanoes, and the formation of natural resources.
You're well-versed in the study of past events, societies, and cultures.
You're a whiz with numbers, calculations, and pattern analysis.
You're skilled in general medicine, a medical specialty, nursing, dentistry, optometry, audiology, or a similar practice.

You study supernatural lore, including parapsychology, paranormal events, and the existence of secret organisations, and you have a working knowledge of tarot or a similar divining practice. It does not usually include knowledge of the Entities and their Avatars.
You're conversant with critically analysing questions of existence, knowledge, ethics, and similar fundamental issues.
You're knowledgeable about the scientifically derived laws of the physical world.
You can code computers and computer architectures, writing applications, developing new systems, and trying to infiltrate protected digital systems.
You're conversant with the study of human behaviour and the therapies developed to address mental health.
You're a pastor or religious leader in a particular faith, and/or knowledgeable about the study of religious beliefs, practices, and traditions.

A sharp memory and a quick grasp of ideas, formal education or not.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Brainy: Smart offers no initial skill, but a larger stat Pool bonus.

  • Eidetic: You remember and can memorise things you experience directly. If a roll is needed to test your memory against something particularly challenging, that roll is eased.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Instead of an extra skill, you may take the Eidetic characteristic.

  • Suggested Inability: You're good at absorbing information, but not at hiding what you know. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.9NS4fm5VOrlzRwHv]{Deception}.

Tough enough to take a lot of punishment. You feel the pain; you just don't let it stop you.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Rugged: Sturdy offers no initial skill, but a larger stat Pool bonus.

  • Resilient: You ignore the first 3 points of Stress you would otherwise take in a day from physical sources, such as Stress from minor wounds. Once that threshold is passed you suffer Stress normally until after your next ten-hour recovery roll, which resets it.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Instead of an extra skill, you may take the Resilient characteristic.

  • Suggested Inability: You're brawny but not mentally flexible. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.2253f39a79c36c71]{Intellect defense}.

You see the patterns others overlook, and you are sure the deepest truths will come into focus.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Folkwise: +2 to your Intellect Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.8d7248fff87386d3]{Occultism}.

  • Throw Salt: When something unquestionably supernatural affects you adversely, you can reroll your defense roll against it. Once per encounter.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Instead of an extra skill, you may take the Throw Salt characteristic.

  • Suggested Inability: You're willing to believe a lot. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.952bfb5f1296eb5b]{Discerning motive}.

You study supernatural lore, including parapsychology, paranormal events, and the existence of secret organisations, and you have a working knowledge of tarot or a similar divining practice. It does not usually include knowledge of the Entities and their Avatars.

The world isn't always safe. You watch for the few bad apples, and it has served you well.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Guarded: +2 to your Might Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.952bfb5f1296eb5b]{Discerning motive}.

  • Suggested Second Skill: Initiative or perception.

  • Suggested Inability: Sometimes you're too suspicious and put people off. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.c4b6b98d92624257]{Persuasion}.
You're practiced at ascertaining another character's lies, motives, and disposition.

Devices have always fascinated you. Give you a new one and you'll use it like a pro, or open it up.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • Technical: +2 to your Intellect Pool.

  • Skill: You're trained in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.dbd4639749e26c4b]{Programming} or @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.20c7b98c5ef86c52]{Electronics}

  • Suggested Second Skill: Any other technical skill, such as electrical repair or engineering.

  • Suggested Inability: You're better with tech than with people. You have an inability in @UUID[Compendium.magnusarchives.skills.Item.952bfb5f1296eb5b]{Discerning motive}.
